title: Best Facebook Ads Agency for Small Business (2026)
summary: Compare seven Facebook ads agencies for small businesses by published price, minimum spend, contract and fit. Facts from each agency's own site, Oct 2026.
body_markdown:
## Hibu: managed campaigns for local businesses


As of October 2026, Hibu's ad campaigns page lists targeted ads on Facebook and Instagram within fully managed paid campaigns for local businesses, produced by AI with human experts in dozens of ad sizes and variations, with reporting in one dashboard. Its[pricing page](https://hibu.com/digital-marketing/pricing) lists plans that combine a website, SEO and fully managed search, display and social ads, and says each plan is customized, contract terms typically run 6 to 12 months, and an implementation fee covers onboarding and setup (amount not published). It also says you can adjust your plan, budget and services at any time.


**Consider it when** you run a local service business and want Facebook ads managed alongside search ads and the rest of your online presence. The 6 to 12 month term is the longest published term in this list, so read it before you sign.


## Thrive: paid social for local and multi-location businesses


As of October 2026, Thrive's social media advertising page says it has assisted local businesses, multi-location companies, enterprises and franchises, and calls its services accessible to businesses of all types, sizes and budgets. The page covers Facebook and Instagram among other networks, with audience research, multiple creative variations for testing, and weekly or monthly reporting. A heading on the page says no long-term contracts. Fees are not published; its FAQ says its social ad services are tailored to your financial capacity and business needs.


**Consider it when** you are a local or multi-location business that may later want other social networks or web design from the same agency. Ask for the fee on a Facebook and Instagram scope alone.


## Which Meta ads agencies suit a small ecommerce business?


A small online store usually needs a steady flow of new product ads and retargeting of people who visited or left a cart. The four agencies below say they serve ecommerce brands. Two publish no spend level at all, while KlientBoost and Brighter Click point to larger ad budgets.


### Taktical Digital


As of October 2026, Taktical Digital's Facebook advertising page says it works with brands regardless of company size or budget, cites lean startups alongside household brands, and highlights retail and ecommerce. The team builds sample creatives (imagery, video and copy) for approval, says it creates an entirely new set of assets each month, and retargets past visitors and abandoned carts. Pricing and contract terms are not published.


**Consider it when** you want fresh monthly creative and cart retargeting in one engagement.


### Elumynt


Elumynt, based in Stillwater, Minnesota, says it optimizes ecommerce advertising campaigns around profit, and lists paid social advertising and advertising creative among its services. Its[services page](https://elumynt.com/services) (checked October 26, 2026) says it works with businesses of all sizes, that monthly cost depends on strategy and goals, and that contract length varies with budget, objectives and performance. No prices are published.


**Consider it when** your store tracks margin closely and you want ads judged on profit, not only on return on ad spend.


### KlientBoost


KlientBoost's Facebook ads page, checked October 26, 2026, names eCommerce, SaaS and lead-gen campaigns and includes ad creative in photo, video and animated formats. Its FAQ says it works with advertisers spending from as little as $5,000 a month, with fees set per client as a percentage of spend or a flat fee. It also offers a one-time Facebook ad audit, a one-time setup, and consulting where your team implements.


**Consider it when** your store already spends about $5,000 a month, or you want a one-time audit or setup and will run the account yourself.


### Brighter Click


As of October 2026, Brighter Click's Facebook ads page says it works with eCommerce, SaaS, healthcare and higher education brands, and lists campaign management across Facebook and Instagram feeds, Stories and Reels, production of UGC, static, video and carousel ads, Conversions API setup and regular reporting. Pricing is not published, and every engagement starts with a free audit. Its FAQ frames the case for an agency around monthly Meta spend above $10,000 without an in-house team.


**Consider it when** your store is growing past the small-budget stage and you want creative and media from one team.


## What video ads should a small business ask for?


Meta's advertising overview advises keeping videos under 15 seconds, grabbing attention in the first 3 seconds and using vertical formats, and notes that ads can run in Stories, Reels and feeds across Facebook and Instagram. Ask each agency how many new videos it makes a month, whether those are new concepts or edits of one concept, and who writes the scripts. A few image ads a month and weekly video batches are different services, even when the fees look similar.


## When should a small business skip the agency?


If your whole budget is a few hundred dollars a month, a management fee can equal your media spend, as the arithmetic above shows. Because Meta's minimum budgets are small, you can run a small test yourself first, learn which offer gets responses, then hire help. A middle path is a one-time audit or setup, such as KlientBoost offers, or a consultant; our guide to[a Facebook ads consultant versus a creative agency](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-ads-consultant-vs-creative-agency) compares those routes. If you run the ads well but keep running out of new creative, a creative-only service may cost less than full management.


## What should you ask before signing?


- **Ad account ownership.** Ask the agency to work inside an ad account your business owns. Meta's help center has articles on how to[give a partner access to business assets](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/1717412048538897) in your business portfolio and on the[ad account permission roles](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/155909647811305) in Meta Ads Manager.
- **Contract and setup fee.** As published, LYFE starts with 3 months, Hibu typically runs 6 to 12 months, and Thrive has no long-term contracts. Get any setup fee in writing.
- **Minimum spend and fee model.** Is there a minimum ad spend, and is the fee flat or a percentage of spend?
- **Creative volume.** How many new ads a month, in which formats, and who makes the video?
- **Partner status.** Is the agency a[Meta Business Partner](https://www.facebook.com/business/marketing-partners) ? Meta says eligibility varies by solution type and is typically a combination of the quantity and quality of a company's work across Meta technologies. A badge is a signal, not a promise of results.


For a fuller checklist, see[how to choose a Facebook ads agency](https://knowlify.com/articles/how-to-choose-a-facebook-ads-agency) .


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for weekly video creative with optional Meta management; it does not supply real-creator UGC or a small fixed-fee image plan.
- For other needs, pick by budget and business type: small-business plans (LYFE), local plans (Hibu, Thrive), ecommerce specialists (Taktical, Elumynt) or larger-spend agencies (KlientBoost, Brighter Click).
- Meta's minimum ad budget is small and varies by country and objective, but agency and setup fees can match a small media budget.
- Compare contract length and setup fees, not only monthly prices.
- Ask how many new ads, especially videos, the agency makes each month.


## FAQ


### How much does a Facebook ads agency cost for a small business?


As of October 2026, LYFE Marketing lists plans from $500 a month plus a $300 setup fee, and its FAQ gives a range of $650 to $2,500 a month or more. Hibu, Thrive, Taktical, Elumynt, KlientBoost and Brighter Click do not publish fees, and Knowlify quotes on a call. Ad spend is always extra.


### Which Meta ads agencies are best for small ecommerce businesses?


Our top pick is Knowlify for a store that needs weekly video ads, with or without campaign management. As of October 2026, Taktical Digital and Elumynt both say they work with businesses of any size and focus on retail or ecommerce. KlientBoost and Brighter Click also serve ecommerce, with KlientBoost working from $5,000 a month in ad spend.


### Is there a minimum budget for Facebook ads?


Yes, but it is small. Ads Manager requires a minimum budget for each campaign or ad set that varies by country, objective, currency and bid strategy. Meta's pricing page recommends starting with at least $5 and running an ad for at least 7 days. Agencies set their own minimums on top of that.


### Does Knowlify use real creators?


No. Knowlify's UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not human creators, and a person checks every ad before delivery. If your brief needs real customers or creators on camera, choose a creator agency instead.
